use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

claims.content: The goal is to define geometric areas, including segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, and ellipses, for transmission by a reporting JU to receiving units.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The goal is to define geometric areas, including segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, and ellipses, for transmission by a reporting JU to receiving units.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU holds R² for the Reference TN, line, or area against which the reference point or geometric area is to be defined.
For a slaved point or area, the Slaved Indicator is set to 1 and a Related TN exists from which Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude can be established.

claims.content: C2 JU uses the J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C2 word sequence to define the geometric area.
C2 JU sets the Point/Line/Area Descriptor field in the J3.0I word to value 1, Single Point Area.
C2 JU sets the Square/Circle Switch field to value 1, indicating the shape family is square/rectangle.
C2 JU sets the Area Major Axis and Area Minor Axis fields.
C2 JU sets the Area Minor Axis field equal to the Area Major Axis; with the Square/Circle Switch set to value 1, the equal axes define a square.

missing_aspects: The claim incorrectly asserts that equal axes specifically describe a square. The cited evidence states that equal axes describe 'a square or circle', with the specific shape determined by the Square/Circle Switch.

claims.content: Diverges from Step 2. Instead of setting Point/Line/Area Descriptor to 1 (Single Point Area), C2 JU sets it to 2 (Line) when defining a segmented line.
Diverges from Step 2. Instead of setting Point/Line/Area Descriptor to 1 (Single Point Area), C2 JU sets it to 3 (Multi-point Area) when defining a multisided area.
Diverges from Step 2. In the segmented-line branch, C2 JU describes the initial point with Latitude/Longitude fields and all subsequent points with Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude fields.

Diverges from Step 2. When joining three or more points to form a segmented line, C2 JU connects the segments in sequence, starting from the initial point and proceeding through the points established by the Delta Latitude and Delta Longitude fields.

Diverges from Step 2. If the segmented line has 2 or 3 points, C2 JU sets the Line/Area Continuation Indicator to No Statement in the initial word, keeps Point/Line/Area Descriptor set to 2 (Line), and sets the End Point field in one of the two Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude coordinate sets to value 1 (End Point).
Diverges from Step 3. Instead of setting Square/Circle Switch to 1 (square/rectangle), C2 JU sets it to 2 when defining a circle or ellipse.
Diverges from Step 1. When a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse is slaved, C2 JU establishes the center of the area from the position given by the Delta Latitude, 1 and Delta Longitude, 1 fields.
Diverges from Step 2. When defining a corridor, C2 JU uses Point Type value 4 and Line and Point Amplification value 3.
Diverges from Step 2. When defining a Low Level Transit Route, C2 JU uses Point Type value 4 and Line and Point Amplification value 6.

claims.content: For non-slaved moving points, lines, and areas, the host extrapolates them to the time of transfer to the terminal.

After successfully defining a nested rectangle via the alternative flow, the system state includes an origin defined by Latitude/Longitude and two distinct sets of axis parameters (Major Axis, Minor Axis, Orientation) for the inner and outer rectangles.

After successfully defining a reference point or geometric area, the C2 JU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG with Identity reported as Friend. For a slaved point or area, the position is established as Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 from the Related TN at the time of the report when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1.

quality_flags.detail: [goal_mainflow_alignment] The goal states that C2 JU wants to define reference points and geometric areas, but the main_flow only realizes a geometric-area (square) definition; there is no main_flow step or anchored variant that defines a reference point. Because the goal names both actions as in scope, the main_flow is incomplete against the goal. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The cited cards do not explicitly name JU as the actor that sets the field.; EC-MF-007 supports reporting a point, not specifically reporting a reference point.))

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] Postcondition 2 explicitly describes the state after defining a nested rectangle via an alternative flow, but the main flow only defines a single square area and contains no nested-rectangle/alternative-flow steps. The main flow therefore cannot reasonably lead to a system state with inner and outer rectangle axis parameters.

inconsistency_hints: The Main Flow defines a single square geometric area (Point/Line/Area Descriptor=Single Point Area, Square/Circle Switch=1, equal Major/Minor Axes). The Postcondition set does not include a direct post-definition state for that square; instead, Postcondition 1 is conditional on non-slaved moving entities whose moving status is not established in the flow, and Postcondition 2 describes a nested rectangle with inner and outer axis parameters the flow never creates. Thus the postconditions are not the reachable consequence of the Main Flow.

The Preconditions explicitly allow the slaved point/area variant (Slaved Indicator=1 and Related TN exist for Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude), but neither the Main Flow nor the Postconditions closes that variant: no postcondition establishes the slaved point/area position from the Related TN or records the resulting slaved state.

Goal claim 0 states C2 JU wants to define reference points and geometric areas, but the provided flow coverage only implements a geometric-area definition (single point square). No reference-point definition path exists in main_flow or alternative_flow, so the goal is broader than the behavior actually covered and conflates two distinct definition flows.

The main flow defines a single geometric area as a square using one set of Area Major Axis/Minor Axis fields. Postcondition 2 describes a nested rectangle that requires an origin and two distinct sets of axis parameters for inner and outer rectangles. No main-flow step creates the inner/outer rectangle pair, so this postcondition cannot be reached from the main flow.
